questions.cardText:
[History] What was the purpose of Napoleon’s Continental System?
A. To create a unified European currency
B. To blockade British trade with continental Europe
C. To promote industrialization in France
Answer: B. The Continental System aimed at crippling the British economy by closing European ports to British goods. Despite its intent to weaken Britain, the blockade also had significant adverse effects on the economies of continental Europe, leading to widespread smuggling and contributing to Napoleon’s eventual downfall.
questions.de: Der Handel welches Landes mit dem europäischen Festland sollte durch Napoleons Kontinentalsperre blockiert werden?
questions.en: Which country's trade with continental Europe was Napoleon's Continental System meant to blockade?

timeline.labelEn: Napoleon's Continental System, an embargo against British trade, from the Berlin Decree until 1814
timeline.labelDe: Napoleons Kontinentalsperre, ein Embargo gegen den britischen Handel, vom Berliner Dekret bis 1814

questions.notes: Answer also accepted: the United Kingdom / the British Empire. Begun with the Berlin Decree of 21 November 1806.

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] What is the second-highest mountain in the world?
A. Mount Kilimanjaro
B. K2
C. Kangchenjunga
